title: Flux FaceIR: High-Quality Face Restoration for Flux
summary: Flux FaceIR is a specialized restoration framework built on the FLUX.2-klein model that supports blind and reference-guided facial enhancement. It utilizes LoRA adapters to restore fine-grained details and maintain identity across single or multiple reference images.
research_notes: Requires high VRAM (22GB+) and the non-quantized FLUX.2-klein-base-4B model. A popular ComfyUI implementation is available via the ComfyUI-Flux-FaceIR repository.

evolution.summary: Released in early April 2026, the project quickly expanded to support full-image restoration using RetinaFace alignment. Recent updates in May 2026 focused on improving ComfyUI integration and fixing device-specific LoRA placement issues.
